metadata.title: आदिवासी बाज़ार में चुनाव का क्या भाव ? | What is the meaning of election in tribal market ?
metadata.description: The weekly haats (Bazaar) are the places where people of adjoining villages gather for shopping. These haats are the best places to understand what's happening in the tribal areas. So for reporting Lok Sabha elections 2024 from jharkhand, we also visited these haats. Watch what people say about voting and candidates.
